text:
kai: quick flag 1: onboarded rwd-lite-int4 to chat routes at 20% last night. overall perf looks ok but small negative drift on the legal-long slice (~-2.8% MRR).

reema: did the canary gates fire?

ci-bot: rollout rwd-lite-int4 -> 20% at 1847774000. no autofallback events logged.

kai: pasted slice deltas (2h window): legal-long -0.028 (n=900), convo 0.002 (n=45k), faq +0.004 (n=12k).

reema: legal-long is under the sample cutoff in our config (min_samples 1000) so it didn't count for auto-fallback. but 900 is close and these are high-value requests.

kai: proposal: add per-slice absolute cutoff: if delta <= -3% AND samples >= 500 => immediate fallback. also lower min_samples for high-value-tagged slices to 500.

ops-bot: noted. can update rollout policy on merge.

reema: agree, but add consecutive-window requirement: delta must be sustained over 2 windows of 15m to avoid flapping.

kai: will open PR for hotfix and short runbook note. running a 2k contrastive judge on legal-long now.

ci-bot: contrastive job queued: job/cc-1847777 (n=2000).

reema: if contrastive confirms, pause ramp to 10% for legal routes until we patch.

kai: thanks. main lesson: min_samples cutoff can hide near-threshold regressions on niche but important slices.
